skill_name: Compare the usage of sass and SCSS in web development.
workflow: Sass has its own syntax and is the original version of CSS preprocessor. It uses indentation to separate code blocks and newline characters to separate rules within a block. SCSS (Sassy CSS) is an extension of CSS that borrows the syntax of Sass with additional features such as variables and nesting. SCSS has the same features as Sass with a CSS-like syntax.
